integrity: Analytic proof and a reproducible Fourier checker are provided; numerical and simulated checks are not proofs. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent centered Gaussian factors only. The two-peak conclusion concerns the reciprocal product with no numerator factors. The number-of-factors modal expansion has O(N^-1) unspecified remainder and does not quantify its finite-N sign. General convolution log-concavity, Edgeworth methods, the original distribution and the qualitative non-unimodality were previously known; the claimed contribution is the explicit exact modal count, Rayleigh-tilted modal correspondence, displacement constant, and typical-size separation. An equivalent specialized result outside the inspected literature is possible.
title: Exactly two reciprocal-normal-product modes and their exponential separation from typical size
